purpose: Teach: 内的/醸成/顕在/利己/襲う/疑わしい/粉砕/萎縮

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、内的な葛藤を抱えた人物の心理史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the psychological history of someone wrestling with internal conflict, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, attentive inquiry. Open-faced, genuinely curious about the student's work. Measured pace, slight lift at the end as a genuine question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、世論を醸成するメディアの役割を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the role of media in shaping public opinion.
lines.style: Clear and direct, but with underlying care in her delivery. Slight pause before responding—she's thinking through her answer. Voice steady and sincere.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 潜在から顕在化した社会問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You addressed how social problems surface from latent to manifest form in your paper, I recall.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective observation. Voice carries warm recognition. Soft pace, giving space for the student to listen. Not testing—witnessing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、利己的遺伝子論の批判史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the critical history surrounding selfish gene theory.
lines.style: Confident but not performative. Slight forward lean in the voice. Brief, assured—she knows her ground here.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 天敵が獲物を襲う行動様式を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And in another piece, you explored predatory behavior patterns and how predators strike their prey.
lines.style: Engaged and attentive, nodding in the voice. Calm, professional tone. Words come easily—genuine interest in the scope of her work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、疑わしい歴史資料の真贋判定を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about authenticating dubious historical documents and distinguishing genuine sources from false ones.
lines.style: Composed, articulate. Voice carries both precision and care. Speaking to something she has thought about carefully. Clear but unhurried.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 岩盤を粉砕する近代工法を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also examined modern techniques for rock extraction—how contemporary methods crush and pulverize bedrock.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective. Slight wonder in the tone—noting the range of her interests. Warm recognition. Paced to let each phrase land.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、過剰な規制が産業を萎縮させる例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I analyzed how excessive regulation can cause industries to contract and shrink.
lines.style: Final response, slightly more settled. Confident and clear. A quiet sense of completion—she has covered her ground. Voice steady to the end.
